title: ClassificationOutputSchema
description: Output schema for item classifier perception. Does NOT include final screening outcomes (ALLOW/REVIEW/ALERT).

predicted_category.description: Standardized category code proposed by the classifier

confidence.description: Model confidence score in [0.0, 1.0], or null if unavailable/uncalibrated

alternative_categories.description: Alternative candidate categories ranked by confidence

classifier_name.description: Identifier of the classifier model or heuristic (e.g. lexical_baseline_v1, qwen3_1.7b_zeroshot)

classifier_version.description: Version or commit tag of the classifier

explanation.description: Rationale, attention evidence, or matched keyword from the classifier

is_uncertain.description: True if confidence is low, missing, or multiple top categories conflict
